svg.title: Antigone, veiled, her hands bound behind her back, her head bowed
svg.desc: Line drawing after the Apulian red-figure amphora by the Darius Painter, c. 350-320 BCE, Berlin, Antikensammlung F 3240; traced from a photograph by ArchaiOptix (CC BY-SA 4.0), taken off the vase's curve, changed. This drawing is CC BY-SA 4.0.
